name: Vallecrosia al Mare (Italy)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, white at the hoist and red at the fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Vallecrosia (a castle on light blue) and the inscription COMUNE DI VALLECROSIA AL MARE in white along the division.
history: Municipal flag of Vallecrosia al Mare, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 26 April 1954.
